title: Teabag-derived microplastics pose steatosis and oxidative stress-mediated toxicity in embryonic zebrafish.
authors: Naser, Shaikh Sheeran; Sahu, Rudra Narayan; Lenka, Sudakshya S; Barik, Debidatta; Kujawska, Malgorzata; Souto, Eliana B; Suar, Mrutyunjay; Verma, Suresh K
one_liner_zh: 该文研究茶包微塑料对斑马鱼胚胎的毒性，涉及分子对接但对象为小分子-蛋白，非蛋白质-DNA互作，与本课题无关。
abstract: Microplastics released from consumer products, such as teabags, are an emerging environmental and health concern. Teabag-derived microplastics (TMPs) represent a significant yet underexplored source of micropollutants. This study investigated the developmental and molecular toxicity of TMPs in zebrafish embryos through integrated experimental and computational approaches. TMPs extracted from commercial teabags had a mean hydrodynamic diameter of 389.7 nm and a zeta potential of -59.4 mV, indicating high colloidal stability. Embryos exposed to TMPs exhibited dose-dependent developmental abnormalities, with up to 45 % mortality and over 30 % incidence of pericardial edema and notochord defects at higher concentrations. ROS levels increased significantly (p < 0.0001), accompanied by lipid droplet accumulation, indicating steatosis. Gene expression analysis showed marked upregulation of Zhe1 (>10-fold), Sod1 (>12-fold), and Tp53 ( approximately 4.5-fold), reflecting hatching stress, oxidative imbalance, and apoptosis. Flow cytometry confirmed elevated acridine orange-positive apoptotic cells. Molecular docking revealed strong binding affinity of styrene, a leachate from TMPs, to Zhe1, Sod1, and p53, with Sod1 showing the highest affinity (-5.4 kcal/mol). These findings suggest TMPs toxicity results not only from physical exposure but also from specific molecular interactions. The study underscores the urgent need to evaluate the risks of microplastic leachates from food-contact materials.
abstract_zh: 消费者产品（如茶包）释放的微塑料是一个新兴的环境和健康问题。茶包来源的微塑料（TMPs）代表了一个重要但尚未充分探索的微污染物来源。本研究通过整合实验和计算方法，调查了TMPs对斑马鱼胚胎的发育和分子毒性。从商业茶包中提取的TMPs平均流体动力学直径为389.7 nm，zeta电位为-59.4 mV，表明其具有高胶体稳定性。暴露于TMPs的胚胎表现出剂量依赖的发育异常，在较高浓度下，死亡率高达45%，心包水肿和脊索缺陷的发生率超过30%。ROS水平显著增加（p < 0.0001），伴随脂滴积累，表明脂肪变性。基因表达分析显示Zhe1（>10倍）、Sod1（>12倍）和Tp53（约4.5倍）显著上调，反映了孵化应激、氧化失衡和细胞凋亡。流式细胞术证实了吖啶橙阳性凋亡细胞增加。分子对接显示，TMPs浸出物中的苯乙烯与Zhe1、Sod1和p53具有强结合亲和力，其中Sod1的亲和力最高（-5.4 kcal/mol）。这些发现表明，TMPs毒性不仅源于物理暴露，还源于特定的分子相互作用。该研究强调了评估食品接触材料中微塑料浸出物风险的紧迫性。
